description: Search Spanish consolidated legislation on the BOE. At least one filter is required: free text, title, department code, legal-range code (law rank), subject-matter code, or a publication date range as YYYYMMDD. Paginate with limit and the opaque cursor. This queries the BOE service live; use the search_legislation tool to search the stella legislation corpus instead.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous search_boe_legislation call for the next page

dateFrom.description: Only laws published on or after this date (YYYYMMDD)

dateTo.description: Only laws published on or before this date (YYYYMMDD)

departmentCode.description: Filter search results by department code

legalRangeCode.description: Filter search results by legal-range code (law rank)

matterCode.description: Filter search results by subject-matter code

title.description: Filter search results by title text
